silhouette.reason: Reads as a dense block of brick walk-ups with flat roofs and streets from the 3/4 views. Nothing West Village-specific reaches the outline: no cornices, stoops, fire escapes, rooftop water tanks or street trees; FRONT/SIDE are a flat skyline strip.
fixes: projecting cornices on each building (seeded depth 0.3–0.6 m)
rooftop water tanks and bulkheads on the taller buildings

proportions.reason: Footprints and heights come from the pinned OSM extract (148.9 × 120 × 22.4 m), so masses are surveyed; storey heights and window sizes look right against the 10 m grid.
fixes: vary storey heights between buildings from their tagged levels so the window rows stop lining up across neighbours

materials.reason: Brick reds, buff and brown facades and dark roofs separate by hue; windows are flat dark rectangles with no glass reflection, and the ground plane shows a fine stripe pattern.
fixes: a glass value on windows (glossy, slightly lighter at the top)
a brick strip on the facades so the walls read as brick up close
replace the ground stripe pattern with sidewalk slabs and asphalt

detail.reason: Windows only: no doors, storefronts, stoops, fire escapes, sills/lintels or roof parapets.
fixes: ground-floor storefronts and doors on street-facing facades
stoops on the row houses and fire escapes on the walk-ups
window sills and lintels as shallow boxes at LOD0

wear.reason: Pristine: no grime, staining, graffiti, roof patching or street dirt.
fixes: grime gradient at street level and soot streaks below cornices
patched roof membranes in varied greys

lod.reason: LOD2 (2.9k) keeps every mass and its colour; windows vanish, which is acceptable at that distance.
fixes: bake the window grid into LOD2 vertex colour so facades do not go blank

technical.reason: QA PASS; one draw; but LOD0 and LOD1 are identical (29 538 / 29 538 / 2 928): the LOD1 level saves nothing.
fixes: make LOD1 drop window frames/insets (ctx.lod gate) so it sits near 10k
